subject: Post-discovery: schedule ML/infra technical deep dive

From: Alex Romero <alex.romero@quantcroft.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap + request to lock technical deep dive

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the call today; appreciate the clarity on latency and cost trade-offs. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goal: reduce per-request latency for interactive docs search (p95 target ~150ms).
- Constraints: ~100 req/s peak, data residency in us-west, SOC2 compliance required for logs.
- Current blocker: our infra team wants a concrete runbook and a 60–90 minute deep technical session to validate KV caching approaches and quantization impact.

Can we lock a 60–90 minute technical deep dive next week with an engineer from your serving/runtime team? We also want to invite our infra lead.

Suggested agenda: 1) brief recap of current discovery, 2) runtime architecture & fallback plan, 3) batching and cache demo, 4) open Q&A + mutual action items.

Available windows for our team (PDT):
- Tue 6/22 10:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed 6/23 09:00–11:30

If you can propose a 90-minute slot and a short pre-read, we can confirm quickly.

Thanks,
Alex Romero
Head of ML Infrastructure
Quantcroft

- Can you include a short smoke demo showing latency at p50/p95 with and without prefix caching?
